narr: Scattered thunderstorms developed across portions of Mississippi. Strong winds and heavy rainfall accompanied a few of these storms.
ev: Several roads were flooded including the intersection of MS Highway 9 and MS Highway 182, the intersection of MS Highway 9 and Fox Avenue, and parts of Waterworks Road.
lsr: Flash flooding reported near the intersection of MS 9 and MS 182, the intersection of MS 9 and Fox Ave, and along Waterworks Rd.
